graphics.notes: RecompFrontend/N64ModernRuntime Config 'graphics' saved as <id>.json in APP_FOLDER_PATH (= files/data, set by BanjoSDLActivity). Flat object; enums stored by their key string ("Auto"), numbers with precision 0 as integers, ds_option as an integer. Saved through a backup file (.bak alongside). Read at start-up and on settings load; the app rewrites it on change. Created on first launch.

general.notes: Config 'general' (camera, note saving, rumble, deadzone). Same rules as graphics.json.

controls.notes: Controller and keyboard bindings (recompinput). Edit in the app.
